QuestInfo.name: New Name, New Home
QuestInfo.1:
You got a suggestion of where to live for a while.
Go to #b#m410000001##k to the left of Fox Point Village.
QuestInfo.2: Chief Silver mistakenly thought your name was 'Human.' You tried to tell him your name, but you were reminded of the person who named you and hesitated for a moment. While you were hesitating, Moonbeam gives you a new name. She calls you #bShade#k because you're so dark and mysterious. You also looked around your new place to live in for a while.
